name: Telekinetic Slam, Mass Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 6, psychic 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Targets one creature/2 levels, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater telekinetic slam except it affects multiple creatures and the maximum is 20d8.
